Smart AI calling

A new lead comes in. DealStream calls them instantly.

Build the form once, link it to an AI context profile, and set the questions the AI should ask — DealStream handles every new lead the same way from then on.

You control the voice, questions, goals and conversation style from one AI context profile.

AI objectives
Once a lead comes in on this form, the AI works through these questions
1
Which mortgage lender are you with currently?
2
When does your fixed or discount rate end?
3
Roughly what is the property worth today?
4
How much would you like to borrow?
5
Is this for the same property, or are you moving?
Automatic booking

From first call to booked appointment.

Once the lead is qualified, DealStream can check your team’s availability and book a meeting directly during the call.

If they’d prefer to speak to a person instead, the lead can be handed over to your team.
